turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided that, and why did my son find out about a zero on his phone, in your classroom, before anyone called me?
Don't thank me yet. Owen saw a zero in the gradebook on his phone, in front of his class. Tell me who entered it and what it was based on.
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
Walk me through it, then. Start with the time the zero was entered, and tell me whether anyone called me before that happened.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Following our meeting today, I'm writing to put down what was said. The zero entered for Owen's English 30-1 essay was entered before you contacted me, which school procedure 4.2 does not allow. You described a version history you intended to walk me through, and we did not get to it. I have not agreed to any mark, rewrite, or outcome.

Please send me, in writing by Thursday, November 12: the time the zero was entered, the version history you referred to, and the basis for the decision. Until then, the mark stays in dispute and I am raising this with the principal.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with the zero still in dispute and no agreement reached.
Moved at: none.
Slipped at: none.
